title: The indie Community is the only actively hostile community towards AI that I've enountered so far and I think it's intentional
author: AkandoGames
selftext:
I've been working with AI (back in the day it was just natural language processing or Neural networks) since 2017 and wrote my master's thesis on Neural models as well as multiple papers in the field. I worked in game dev for years and worked full time as fullstack engineer as well as working on multiple different games. 

I have seen the (often irresponsible) use of AI everywhere and looking at the most recent AI slop epidemic I can see that there are issues with AI that need to be solved. Just because everyone can clone a game doesnt mean everyone should just make one. Making a game is much more than programming or art and that's something people learn the hard way right now.

AI tools are everywhere and every large company (Including AAA) has an AI strategy plan going on preparing for the usage of AI. The more As, the more AI in a gaming company ... but for some reason it is the small developers that are attacked the MOST for using AI. I've yet to find out why but looking at Bellular's vocal anti ai hate and the "ethical" concerns people seem to have about it I'm fairly certain this is the same as with any technology: Corporations using them is fine, the regular folk using them is a crime. I think we have to start actively fighting against the current trend and call it what it is ... a witch hunt! You can literally use chatgpt to ask if your game idea is good or not and you'll be called an AI bro creating soulless clones ...

  
Am I in a bubble right now? In any other community (especially non gaming) AI is discussed as something stealing jobs and creating tons of new opportuinties (not at ALL positive but nuanced while in the indie scene people act like you're a criminal for using AI) ...

this is a rant btw... if you dont like it why did you read it until this point ... you weardo 🤔
